headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while others saw modest or slowing expansion.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI‑related services contributed noticeably to earnings at Infosys, LTM and TCS. Margin guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge. Profit performance was mixed, with Wipro reporting a dip and most peers posting gains.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Infosys, LTM and TCS highlighted double‑digit AI revenue growth and new AI‑led deals.

themes.title: Margin guidance shifts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue growth guidance, while Coforge raised its EBIT margin target to 16%.
